Why go: a true luxury motor yacht for a day or a night

The Princess 64 is a British-built 64 ft motor yacht with four air-conditioned cabins, a flybridge and twin 1,200 hp engines that cruise at about 18 knots. That speed means Ang Thong or Koh Tao can be reached in comfort, with time for snorkelling and a long lunch on board. Champagne and beer are included at every length, and the overnight includes all meals and drinks.

For a shorter treat, the half day visits Koh Tan and Pig Island off the south coast, and the 2 hour sunset is priced for a couple.

Who it suits, and who should choose something else

  • Good for: special occasions, proposals, families and small groups who want the comfort of a large yacht.
  • Choose something else if you want a similar day for less: a sailing catamaran costs a fraction, at a slower pace.
  • Celebrating as a couple? Our honeymoon guide lists other ideas.

Good to know

  • Ang Thong: the park is closed from 1 November to 15 December.
  • Shoes: yachts usually ask guests to go barefoot on deck.
  • Fees: island and park fees are paid in cash on the day.
  • Weather: a motor yacht is more comfortable than a speedboat in chop, but the crew will still avoid open-water crossings in strong monsoon wind.

Choosing the right option

The half day to Koh Tan and Pig Island is the shortest trip with real swimming and snorkelling. Full days are where the yacht's speed pays off: Koh Tao and Ang Thong are within comfortable reach with a long lunch on board. The overnight is a private floating hotel for up to four, with all meals included.
